import subprocess,sys,json,threading,urllib.request,base64,time
from pathlib import Path
sid,cap,proof=sys.argv[1:4]
proc=subprocess.Popen(sys.argv[4:])
Path(proof).write_text(json.dumps({"session":sid,"cli_pid":proc.pid,"cap_seconds":int(cap),"started_epoch":time.time()}))
def stop():
 cfg=json.loads(Path("/Users/matthewsmith/.config/opencode/service.json").read_text())
 req=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:49374/api/session/"+sid+"/interrupt?resume=false",data=b"",method="POST")
 req.add_header("Authorization","Basic "+base64.b64encode(("opencode:"+cfg["password"]).encode()).decode())
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as response: status=response.status
 except Exception as exc: status=type(exc).__name__
 Path(proof).with_suffix(".deadline.json").write_text(json.dumps({"session":sid,"interrupt":status,"at_epoch":time.time()}))
 try:proc.wait(timeout=15)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.terminate()
timer=threading.Timer(int(cap),stop);timer.start()
try:code=proc.wait()
finally:timer.cancel()
sys.exit(code)
